cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(elym LANGUAGES C)

add_library(elym INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(elym INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_compile_features(elym INTERFACE c_std_99)

include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_executable(test_util)
    target_link_libraries(test_util PRIVATE elym)
    add_test(NAME test_util COMMAND test_util)

    # cmsync:begin target_sources:test_util
    target_sources(test_util PRIVATE
        tests/test_util.c
    )
    # cmsync:end target_sources:test_util
endif()
